|game_text=Deploy on table. Rebel scouts (except pilots) are troopers. Rebel troopers have armor = 4 and are immune to [[Physical Choke]]. Whenever you deploy a Rebel trooper, may immediately ▼ [[Blaster Rifle (V) (Virtual Block 9){{!}}Blaster Rifle]] on that character. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image here is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-133E-Heroic_Sacrifi_ce.png]]). The same words were published again on the Players Committee card image and in the Virtual Cards Master List of 2013; the current text is [[Rebel Infantry (Errata 3)]] (Master List, PC-E3).
* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Block 2 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 133E)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=9 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 9, slip 133E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table. Rebel scouts (except pilots) are troopers. Rebel troopers have armor = 4 and are immune to Physical Choke. Whenever you deploy a Rebel trooper, may immediately ▼ Blaster Rifle on that character. (Immune to Alter.)” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-133E-Heroic_Sacrifi_ce.png]]) prints it. The slip prints slip number 133E at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Rebel Infantry (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 2 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1220_133">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock2Type (Virtual Block 2 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205214/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Deploy on table. Rebel scouts (except pilots) are troopers. Rebel troopers have armor = 4 and are immune to Physical Choke. Whenever you deploy a Rebel trooper, may immediately ▼ a Blaster Rifle on that character. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' One change: “a” is added before “Blaster Rifle”. The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Rebel Infantry (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-L-rebelinfantry-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date-Virtual2-Light">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual2-Light/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034559/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Light/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>: “Deploy on table. Rebel scouts (except pilots) are troopers. Rebel troopers have armor = 4 and are immune to Physical Choke. Whenever you deploy a Rebel trooper, may immediately ▼ Blaster Rifle on that character. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word, undoing the card-list changes listed under PC-E1. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date, and what was uploaded last counts as the last version). Besides the words, the image differs from the release-sheet slip in one visible way: it prints a different slip number, 134E (the release-sheet slip prints 133E).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Rebel Infantry (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 27)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=27 Internet Archive]</ref>, slip [[:File:VL-history-1220-133-front-master.png]]: “Deploy on table. Rebel scouts (except pilots) are troopers. Rebel troopers have armor = 4 and are immune to Physical Choke. Whenever you deploy a Rebel trooper, may immediately ▼ Blaster Rifle on that character. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word (the same words as the PC card image, PC-E2). The Master List slip prints no slip number, only the E mark at the bottom right. Every published text is a version, even a word-for-word repeat (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
